items.name: iFixAi
items.tagline: Independent auditing of AI agents to uncover misalignment
items.description: iFixAi is an independent auditor helping companies assess whether they can trust their AI agents. Unlike relying solely on evals and observability tools, its multifaceted audit includes 250 inspections across 69 categories of AI misalignment, combining AI red teaming, operational assurance, and philosophical, ethical, and sociological perspectives. It identifies failures under testing, explains their business implications, and provides evidence engineers can use to investigate and fix them.

items.name: LUCI Desktop
items.tagline: Let your AI agents remember what you've seen
items.description: Luci saves your screen history and meeting transcripts locally, so agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can help you find a page you forgot to bookmark or recall a decision from a call. Capture context across apps without setting up a connector for each one. Includes on-device transcription and daily summaries with Microsoft Foundry Local. Free for Mac and Windows.

items.name: ZenABM
items.tagline: Create, optimize & report on LinkedIn Ads from any AI tool
items.description: Ditch copy-pasting into Campaign Manager! Create, launch & optimize your LinkedIn Ad Campaigns from your favourite AI tool (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity etc.) with ZenABM’s MCP server or natively with our AI Agent Zena - both equipped with 20+ expert skills and 96 tools! +Automate your reporting (including company engagements & revenue attribution) with weekly & monthly reports produced by our AI Agents Zena.

items.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.tagline: Anthropic's second model in the Claude 5.5 family
items.description: Claude Sonnet 5.5 is Anthropic’s fast, cost-efficient AI model for everyday work: coding, bug fixes, documents, slides, and design. It runs 30%+ faster than Sonnet 5, lowers task costs up to 30%, and delivers stronger coding and knowledge-work performance.

items.name: Semos.ai Manager Agents
items.tagline: AI agents purpose-built for managers
items.description: Manager Agents learn from your meetings, then point you to what needs your attention next: the feedback that is overdue, the recognition you missed, the conflict you are avoiding, the growth talk that keeps slipping. You learn what works, what doesn't, and why, so you become better at leading your people.

items.name: Paste 7
items.tagline: Intelligent clipboard that knows what you're about to paste
items.description: Intelligent Clipboard is new in Paste, the productivity app that remembers everything you copy. Paste now suggests which of your copied items you'll most likely paste next, based on what you're working on. Powered by Apple Intelligence, privately on your Mac.

items.name: Hopscotch AI
items.tagline: 500+ AI models available via a single API
items.description: 🎁 PRODUCT HUNT EXCLUSIVE: The first 250 PH users to sign up get $50 in free model credits. Create your free account and redeem code HOPSCOTCH50OFF in the Billing tab. | 🚀 Access 500+ AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and more through one API. Use multiple providers without managing separate integrations, accounts, or payments. Compare models on your prompts, configure fallbacks, and track usage and spend in one place. Pay provider rates with no platform fees or token markup.

items.name: Timeless Code
items.tagline: Meeting notetaker that installs and runs inside Claude Code
items.description: An AI notetaker that lives inside Claude Code. Claude sets it up for you, and from then on you can record meetings and ask about anything that was said, right from your terminal.

items.name: Would you pay?
items.tagline: Find out who'd pay before you build more
items.description: Most side projects fail quietly: months of building, then nobody pays. Would you pay? shows your startup to real people who swipe right only if they'd pay for it. You see the % who'd pay, who they are, and who clicked through. Free.

items.name: Pokébinder
items.tagline: Plan your Pokémon binder, then print what's missing
items.description: A free binder planner for Pokémon TCG collectors. Search 40,000+ English and Japanese cards, arrange 3×3 pages, run your own art behind a whole page with cards on top, then print true-size placeholders for the cards you don't own yet. No account — your binder stays in your browser.

items.name: Engine Room Media
items.tagline: We Run The Numbers. You Run The Show.
items.description: Built for Creator growth, Engine Room brings all of your platform analytics, media kit, and rate cards together in one easy to use dashboard. Engine Room Media helps creators grow across all their favorite platforms (including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Patreon, Spotify, and Twitch) with data-driven insights, brand deals, and peer connections.

items.name: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude
items.tagline: Create, send, and sign documents in ChatGPT and Claude
items.description: Jotform Sign for ChatGPT and Claude brings document creation and e-signatures directly into your AI workspace. Create signature-ready documents from a prompt or uploaded file, edit content and signing fields, manage recipients and signing order, send documents for signature, and track their progress without switching tools. Existing Jotform Sign users can also access and manage their workflows right from ChatGPT or Claude.

items.name: Curie
items.tagline: Assistant for scientific literature and document analysis.
items.description: Curie is an AI research assistant built for real scientific work, not a generalist chatbot. It searches PubMed, arXiv, Europe PMC, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar in parallel, then verifies every claim against the source text, so you see what's backed and what isn't. Point it at a document to extract structured data with the quote behind each value, or run a full systematic review, protocol, screening, PRISMA diagram, with you approving every decision. Projects and a library keep it organized.

items.name: Arsaze
items.tagline: Let Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini edit your real timeline
items.description: Arsaze is the AI video editor for agents and humans — think Cursor for video editing. A real multi-track timeline that both you and an AI agent can drive over MCP or by talking to it, for AI video editing, AI video generation, and agent-driven video editing on one real timeline.

items.name: Imejis.io
items.tagline: Give your agent a design studio to automate your marketing
items.description: Your AI agent writes the copy. With Imejis, it ships the image too. Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other AI agents a design studio via MCP. Create, edit, preview, and render production-ready graphics. Build OG images, social cards, marketing graphics, charts, certificates, QR codes and more. Design once. Generate at scale. Unlike generative image models, Imejis is deterministic: the same input produces the same pixels, keeping your brand, layout, typography, and data consistent. Free to start

items.name: Gladys Assistant 5
items.tagline: Private, self-hosted smart home, no YAML required
items.description: Gladys Assistant is a free, open-source smart home platform that runs on your own mini-PC or Raspberry Pi. Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter and 90+ community integrations, a phone-first dashboard, no YAML, and it keeps working when the internet goes down.

items.name: Supertake
items.tagline: AI that turn your ideas into real investments
items.description: Supertake transforms your unique takes on the world into real, shareable investment portfolios using frontier AI and trading agents. Until now, we’ve invested at the mercy of financial managers, ETFs, and single stocks promoted by grifters and algorithms. But with Supertake you simply tell the agent what you believe in natural language and it creates a magical portfolio of assets and places the trades on your behalf. Supertake works with existing brokerages like Robinhood and Coinbase.

items.name: Declutr
items.tagline: Tidy your Mac's desktop and downloads in one click
items.description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. One Undo puts every file back. New since the first launch: it's on the Mac App Store, with Smart Rules (name, extension, age, size), watched folders that sort new files as they land, and a daily cleanup. Rules, not AI: it never reads what's inside your files. Free to sort, Pro is $8.99 once.

items.name: Clink
items.tagline: The iOS keyboard you actually own
items.description: Clink is a custom iOS keyboard and a place for indie apps and brands to live on it. Themes, layouts and tools you control, plus partners who put their brand in the thing you type with all day. Privacy focused and headed to Android soon!

items.name: GhostDeck
items.tagline: Offline Mac music player with living low-poly worlds
items.description: GhostDeck plays your own music files in the classic late-'90s deck layout, with a ten-band EQ and a playlist that snap together. Behind your album, a jewel case turns over one of five low-poly worlds that move to the music. Native Metal, offline, no tracking.
